title: A store over your own functions — dedup_backend
text: function(hashes): logical vector, one element per digest, TRUE chunk stored. get function(hash): chunk's bytes raw vector, NULL stored. put function(hash, bytes): stores chunk. must atomic: returns, (hash) TRUE get(hash) returns bytes, crash must leave partial chunk () reports. second put digest bytes must harmless. delete function(hashes), optional: removes chunks; needed dedup_delete() dedup_gc(). list function(), optional: digests every stored chunk; needed dedup_verify() dedup_gc(). hash, min, avg, max backend's chunks made , dedup_chunk().

title: A store over your own functions — dedup_backend
text: dedup_backend, every store function accepts.

title: A store over your own functions — dedup_backend
text: backend also records hash algorithm chunking parameters chunks made . Every store function refuses manifest made different ones, zudedup_algorithm_error. default hash, XXH3-128, fast cryptographic: store parties trust can write , use hash = "sha256".

title: A store over your own functions — dedup_backend
code: env <- new.env() store <- dedup_backend(   has = function(hashes) vapply(hashes, exists, TRUE, envir = env,                                 inherits = FALSE, USE.NAMES = FALSE),   get = function(hash) get0(hash, envir = env, inherits = FALSE),   put = function(hash, bytes) assign(hash, bytes, envir = env),   delete = function(hashes) rm(list = hashes, envir = env),   list = function() ls(env) ) m <- dedup_put(store, serialize(mtcars, NULL)) identical(unserialize(dedup_get(store, m)), mtcars) #> [1] TRUE

title: Split bytes into content-defined chunks — dedup_chunk
text: Finds chunk boundaries FastCDC: gear rolling hash bytes, normalised chunking sizes cluster around avg. boundary depends bytes near , insertion deletion changes chunks around leaves rest alone. bytes give chunks every platform every version zudedup, however read.

title: Split bytes into content-defined chunks — dedup_chunk

title: Split bytes into content-defined chunks — dedup_chunk
text: x raw vector, connection, path file. connection open opened, read closed; open one must binary mode read current position end, blocks 1 MiB. min, avg, max Chunk sizes bytes. chunk shorter min except last, none longer max, mean close avg, must power two. min [64, 2^26], avg [256, 2^28] max [1024, 2^30], min <= avg <= max. hash digest chunk: "xxh3" (XXH3-128, 32 hex characters, default) "sha256" (64 hex characters, needs zucrypt package).

title: Split bytes into content-defined chunks — dedup_chunk
text: data frame one row per chunk, order: offset, 0-based position first byte (double, since inputs may exceed 2^31 bytes), length, size bytes (integer), hash, digest lower-case hex. empty input chunks.

title: Split bytes into content-defined chunks — dedup_chunk
text: default hash, XXH3-128, fast cryptographic: adversary chooses content can make two chunks digest. Use hash = "sha256" matters.

title: Split bytes into content-defined chunks — dedup_chunk
code: x <- as.raw(sample(0:255, 200000, replace = TRUE)) chunks <- dedup_chunk(x) head(chunks) #>   offset length                             hash #> 1      0   6417 01190bf2b84bcdc37e9e2fb8c86e0220 #> 2   6417   7155 369c53992d1a356cddb8fe4f1e7a184b #> 3  13572  17779 d64dd19372080ca51506ee01b86469a2 #> 4  31351  10520 642cc92900574b015ac37afb71fc2b1b #> 5  41871   9488 4115c04a9234e8c084e944069ae097a6 #> 6  51359  13335 ae514930c17e8348bbc2055798ed5039 sum(chunks$length) == length(x) #> [1] TRUE  # An insertion near the start leaves the later chunks in place. y <- c(as.raw(1:100), x) mean(dedup_chunk(y)$hash %in% chunks$hash) #> [1] 0.9583333

title: Conditions raised by zudedup — zudedup-conditions
text: Every error zudedup raises carries condition class, can caught kind rather matching message, may change. Every class inherits zudedup_error.

title: Conditions raised by zudedup — zudedup-conditions
text: zudedup_invalid_argument argument unusable: chunking parameters range, malformed manifest, unknown hash algorithm, backend without function operation needs. condition carries arg, argument fault. zudedup_store_error chunk missing store, bytes hash name, store unusable. condition carries problem, "missing" "corrupt" chunk (NA otherwise); hash, chunk's digest; index, 1-based position manifest, apply. zudedup_algorithm_error manifest's hash algorithm chunking parameters differ store's another manifest's. zudedup_io_error connection file read written. zudedup_limit_error limit reached. condition carries limit, argument's name, "max_chunks", limit_value.

title: Conditions raised by zudedup — zudedup-conditions
code: tryCatch(   dedup_chunk(raw(10), avg = 5000),   zudedup_invalid_argument = function(e) e$arg ) #> [1] "avg"

title: zudedup 0.0.0.9000
text: development version first release, 0.1.0 (heading becomes # zudedup 0.1.0 submitted). dedup_chunk() splits raw vector, connection file content-defined chunks FastCDC. boundaries format: bytes give chunks every platform, whatever block size arrive , agree Python fastcdc package (1.7.0) given zudedup’s gear table. dedup_chunk() gives chunk’s digest, dedup_manifest() records object’s chunk digests, lengths, size whole-object digest. XXH3-128 (zufast, digest xxhsum -H2 prints) default cryptographic; hash = "sha256" uses zucrypt. dedup_store() opens creates content-addressed store directory, dedup_backend() builds one five functions . dedup_put() writes chunks store lacks; dedup_get() reassembles object, refusing missing corrupt chunk; dedup_has(), dedup_missing() dedup_delete() act digests. zudedup_info() reports build, format constants hash algorithms available.
